cohort: The study included 86 postpartum primiparous women, comprising 43 who underwent primary caesarean section and 43 who had vaginal delivery.
finding: Sonographic elastography detected more trauma-suspicious lesions than B-mode investigation and revealed a significantly higher median Trauma_Index in women after vaginal delivery compared to those after caesarean section.
mod_finding: The median Trauma_Index was significantly higher in women who had undergone vaginal delivery compared to those who had a primary caesarean section.
